full_judgment: 24. The same view appears to have been adopted by a Division Bench of the said High Court (Sen and Niyamatullah, JJ.) in the case of Jagannath Sahu Vs. Chhedi Sahu, A.I.R. 1929, All. 144. No notice as required under paragraph 5(2) of Schedule 2, C.P. Code having been served, the appointment of an arbitrator by the Court was held in the said case to be invalid.
